# Postmortem

Load `skills/ops-postmortem/SKILL.md`. Use it after the incident, when user impact has stopped.

Write a blameless timeline from the alerts and the deploy record. Name contributing factors. Give each action item an owner and a date. Do not assign personal blame, and do not change production while writing this.
